acceptance.title: Account access
acceptance.outcomes: Sign up, email confirmation, login, recovery, email change, MFA, revoked/inactive sessions, logout clears private state. Web Account highlights Security & password, which includes password visibility controls, email reauthentication when required, and built-in authenticator settings; legacy security links redirect safely.

acceptance.title: Company and team
acceptance.outcomes: Create, edit, select companies; unified workspace; manager uploads/replaces private company photo visible in both clients; 5 MB image-only bounds, stale replacement rejection and secure cleanup; invite/accept/revoke roles, seat limits, restricted scopes; lost create acknowledgement stops repeat writes.

acceptance.title: Company verification
acceptance.outcomes: Prepare, upload, preview, remove, submit, rejection/resubmit and read-only submitted status; referenced bytes survive failed detach.

acceptance.title: Discovery and supplier catalogue
acceptance.outcomes: Guest browse in both clients permits draft query/category and prompts sign-in before product access or submitted search/filter, preserving intent after protected authentication; private prices/details stay protected. Supplier photo and actual five-star rating on product detail; related visible products exclude current product. Search, available categories, filters, sort, pagination, saved listing/supplier; complete results at low API caps; unavailable records. Web save feedback disappears without shifting page layout. Search activity and photo decoding show loaders without temporary broken-image placeholders.

acceptance.title: Seller listings
acceptance.outcomes: Draft, specifications, images, edit, moderation, publication and status changes; partial upload/review retry retains draft and completed files. Both seller workspaces use counted status filters and one floating permission-aware post button that stays above navigation and safe areas. Pending Review is an amber timer state explaining private visibility and paused editing; historical rejection notes disappear after resubmission. Visible statuses use Title Case without changing submitted enum values.

acceptance.title: Public RFQs
acceptance.outcomes: Draft/edit/save/review, retired categories, deadlines, supplier invitations, attachment preview/removal; request identity and publication permissions. Opening a successfully created enquiry uses the actual saved_enquiries composite key; page errors offer Retry to that enquiry rather than Account.

acceptance.title: Direct enquiry
acceptance.outcomes: Web-created private enquiry is visible in Flutter with the same supplier, listing, quantity, currency and conversation.

acceptance.title: Quotes and notifications
acceptance.outcomes: Flutter-created quote appears on web; optional values/currency survive; actual quote ID opens correct parent; version history, compare, withdrawal/rejection and one accepted deal.

acceptance.title: Messages and attachments
acceptance.outcomes: Text appears promptly in both clients; captioned private photos embed and open viewer; file attachments, report per message, history, unread/archive; retry deduplicates and account switch cancels outbox. Web Enter sends, Shift Enter adds a line, IME composition never submits; routine connected/sending/sent notices are hidden while failures/retry remain visible. Web outgoing bubbles show a clock while pending, one tick only after confirmation, and double seen ticks from the backend read state; accessible labels distinguish them in initial rendering and refreshed history.

acceptance.title: Deal progress and reviews
acceptance.outcomes: One accepted deal, milestones, delivery/tracking, documents, completion, company reviews and transaction-party scope.

acceptance.title: Saved searches
acceptance.outcomes: Save/edit/delete, matches, alerts, frequency and ownership.

acceptance.title: Notifications and preferences
acceptance.outcomes: Preferences, unread count, mark-read, deep links and cross-company access. Native push/device checks; browser push explicitly deferred. Compact activity cards show the original message or resource preview, sender company when authorized, context and timestamp. Deleted or no-longer-authorized resources reveal no preview. Notification storage and OS pushes remain minimized; in-app enrichment uses current resource RLS, never a newer unrelated message. Failed read/delete actions preserve items and offer retry.

acceptance.title: Profile and billing
acceptance.outcomes: Names/contact/location/email confirmation, plans, request/cancel changes, billing history and seat limits. Personal profile photo uploads/replaces in both clients without requiring company membership, appears on Account and web header; private owner-only access, 5 MB image bounds, concurrent replacement protection and safe cleanup.

acceptance.title: Privacy and safety
acceptance.outcomes: Report, block/unblock, schedule/cancel deletion, processing/failed states; independent loading/error sections, never false-empty unknown deletion state.

acceptance.title: Support and exports
acceptance.outcomes: Submit support case, rate limits/lengths, case ownership, quote/enquiry/deal PDF values, paging/export bounds, security headers and private cache.

acceptance.title: Cross-client security
acceptance.outcomes: Every write rechecks active user, membership, scope, verification and business state; no private data/media accessible to unrelated user; revoked permission and close/accept race.

acceptance.title: Web browser and layout
acceptance.outcomes: Desktop Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and phone emulation; narrow screens/text zoom, overflow, keyboard focus, dialogs, disabled empty Send, image viewer and attachment popups. Avatar beside Notifications opens an accessible account menu; signed-out Log in links directly to login without a dropdown; activity and image loaders preserve layout. Public and signed-in pages share a branded responsive footer. Category and primary navigation links have hover/keyboard focus feedback; saved navigation includes a heart, file selection uses a visible button, and Sell has a red circular icon in desktop/mobile navigation. Public Buyers and Vendors pages describe implemented capabilities. About Salam Sourcing and the audience pages are discoverable from navigation/footer and indexed public sitemap. Every layout has a sticky Get the app entry; iOS/Android are Coming Soon until public store URLs exist.

acceptance.title: Flutter devices
acceptance.outcomes: Android and iOS: keyboard/safe areas, haptics, file pickers/photos, CAPTCHA, MFA, PDF viewing and lifecycle/reconnect. Native home, guest and auth headers use the same two-line Salam wordmark; iOS launcher/store artwork and Android legacy/adaptive launcher icons use the existing emblem and wordmark. Verify installed icon masking and legibility on devices.

acceptance.title: Listing display currency
acceptance.outcomes: Choose original supplier currency or a preferred display currency in Account. Sync after refresh or resume on web and Flutter; convert listing cards, saved and supplier catalogues, related listings and details, retaining units, original price and rate date. Quotes, deals, stored supplier prices and filters retain original currencies. Handle unavailable or stale rates, fractional unit prices, zero and three-decimal currencies, and account switching. Native selector, save and retry taps give haptics.
